dz: 拉迪斯劳斯后宫被加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
de: Ladislaus the Posthumous is crowned king of Bohemia in Prague.

t: 克里斯蒂安一世加冕为丹麦国王。
te: Christian I is crowned king of Denmark.
dz: 克里斯蒂安一世加冕为丹麦国王。
de: Christian I is crowned king of Denmark.

t: 紫禁城建成后，北京正式定为明朝首都。
te: Beijing is officially designated the capital of the Ming dynasty when the Forbidden City is completed.
dz: 紫禁城建成后，北京正式定为明朝首都。
de: Beijing is officially designated the capital of the Ming dynasty when the Forbidden City is completed.

t: 斯米尔纳的下城被拉丁基督徒俘虏,以应对斯米尔尼奥特战役期间的阿伊德尼德海盗.
te: The lower town of Smyrna is captured by Latin Christians in response to Aydınid piracy during the Smyrniote crusades.
dz: 斯米尔纳的下城被拉丁基督徒俘虏,以应对斯米尔尼奥特战役期间的阿伊德尼德海盗.
de: The lower town of Smyrna is captured by Latin Christians in response to Aydınid piracy during the Smyrniote crusades.

t: 皮埃特罗·卡达罗被德意志帝国宫廷任命为前一个月入选的亚历山大二世教宗的反波佩.
te: Pietro Cadalo is appointed by the German Imperial court as antipope to the pope Alexander II, who was elected in the pr…
dz: 皮埃特罗·卡达罗被德意志帝国宫廷任命为前一个月入选的亚历山大二世教宗的反波佩.
de: Pietro Cadalo is appointed by the German Imperial court as antipope to the pope Alexander II, who was elected in the previous month.

t: 拜占庭帝国从阿拉伯统治下收复了安提俄克.
te: The Byzantine Empire recovers Antioch from Arab rule.
dz: 拜占庭帝国从阿拉伯统治下收复了安提俄克.
de: The Byzantine Empire recovers Antioch from Arab rule.

t: 君士坦丁一世在米尔维安桥之战中击败马克森提乌斯，成为西方唯一的罗马皇帝。
te: Constantine I defeats Maxentius in the battle of the Milvian Bridge, becoming the sole Roman emperor in the West.
dz: 君士坦丁一世在米尔维安桥之战中击败马克森提乌斯，成为西方唯一的罗马皇帝。
de: Constantine I defeats Maxentius in the battle of the Milvian Bridge, becoming the sole Roman emperor in the West.

t: 马克森提斯被封为罗马皇帝.
te: Maxentius is proclaimed Roman emperor.
dz: 马克森提斯被封为罗马皇帝.
de: Maxentius is proclaimed Roman emperor.

t: 罗马皇帝内尔瓦被普拉托里亚卫队所逼取将领马库斯·乌尔皮乌斯·特拉亚努斯为继承人和接班人.
te: Roman emperor Nerva is forced by the Praetorian Guard to adopt general Marcus Ulpius Trajanus as his heir and successor.
dz: 罗马皇帝内尔瓦被普拉托里亚卫队所逼取将领马库斯·乌尔皮乌斯·特拉亚努斯为继承人和接班人.
de: Roman emperor Nerva is forced by the Praetorian Guard to adopt general Marcus Ulpius Trajanus as his heir and successor.
